name: How should I prepare my home before a handyman arrives?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before a handyman arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your handyman arrives, clear the immediate work area and compile a prioritized list of all tasks. Removing personal items, furniture, and wall decor around the repair zone allows technicians immediate access and protects your belongings from dust. If the work involves patching or trim replacement, locating leftover matching paint, spare tiles, or specific wood profiles beforehand saves substantial project time. Clearly communicating your top priorities ensures the most urgent repairs receive attention first if your project list covers multiple rooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear personal items from the work area, gather any matching paint or spare materials, and prepare a prioritized list of tasks to ensure efficient work.
